layout.tagline: Daily Coding, one coding challenge a day.

verification.subject: Confirm your email address – Daily Coding
verification.heading: Confirm your email
verification.line: Almost done. Confirm your address and you can get started on your first challenge.
verification.footer: This link is valid for 24 hours.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password – Daily Coding
passwordReset.heading: Reset password
passwordReset.line: You can set a new password for your account here.
passwordReset.footer: This link is valid for 1 hour. If you did not ask for a reset, just ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Daily Coding!
welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
welcome.lineOne: Every day a new coding challenge is waiting for you, in the programming language of your choice.
welcome.lineTwo: Solve it, collect points and keep your streak alive.

accountDeletion.subject: Account deleted – Daily Coding
accountDeletion.heading: Account deleted
accountDeletion.lineOne: Hello {name}, your Daily Coding account has been deleted.
accountDeletion.lineTwo: Your submissions and your score are gone with it.
accountDeletion.footer: If this was not you, please get in touch with us right away. This address can be used for a new account at any time.

solutionActivity.subject: New activity on your solution – Daily Coding
solutionActivity.heading: Activity on your solution
solutionActivity.bestPractices: {actor} thinks your solution to "{challenge}" is exemplary.
solutionActivity.clever: {actor} thinks your solution to "{challenge}" is clever.
solutionActivity.footer: You can switch these notifications off in your settings at any time.
